I used to work in mortgages and here is my advice:

Find one company you like and get fully approved by providing all required documents and go through the entire process.

DO NOT “lock in” your rate. Tell them once you are fully approved tell them you want them to strategically lock your rate on a short term when they are ready to “go to signing phase” and generate the Docs for Closing.

The shorter the “lock term” the better rate you can lock.

Don’t get greedy.

Don’t try to “time the market” and overthink getting “the lowest possible rate.”

The difference between a 3.35% and a 3% and a 3.5% isn’t worth stressing over. Just lock in something and move on with your life.

Always pay extra towards your loan to pay off sooner—this effectively “lowers your rate” by shortening the length of your loan payoff and thereby helping you to pay far less in interest than if you hold the loan for the length of loan.
